# EMS Readability

Single-line SVG font by Sheldon B. Michaels, SVG conversion by Windell H.
Oskay, a derivative of Source Sans Pro by Paul D. Hunt (Adobe). From the
Inkscape extensions repository (`svg_fonts/EMSReadability.svg`).

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`). Etonia uses its
glyphs as pen strokes for AI notation: `tool/build_notation_glyphs.py`
converts them into `lib/features/editor/ai/notation_glyphs.dart`. The
license is shown on the app's licenses page.
